newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo rubber futures end lower on yen's steep rise.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo rubber futures end lower on yen's steep rise.

text.p: Tokyo rubber futures ended lower across the board on Wednesday, as the yen's further gains against the dollar stimulated long liquidation, traders said.
Prices ranged from 1.9 yen to 2.7 yen per kg lower. Benchmark November was off 2.7 yen at 133.0 yen.
"The yen's steep appreciation against the dollar caught market players here off guard and prompted them to liquidate their longs," one analyst at a commodity broker said.
Traders said sentiment in rubber futures turned bearish.
"Benchmark November may probe the downside at 131.0 yen," the analyst said.
